job.title: Build a customer churn prediction baseline
job.description: Create a reproducible Python baseline using tabular customer data. Compare logistic regression and random forest, report precision/recall, and document limitations.
screening_questions: How would you evaluate an imbalanced classifier?

proposal:
Proposal: Build a customer churn prediction baseline

I will prepare the client's data by cleaning and transforming the provided tabular customer data.
I will build and compare the requested models using logistic regression and random forest algorithms.
I will evaluate the precision, recall, and report limitations of the models.

Relevant portfolio evidence:

[evidence-001] "Built a reproducible classification experiment with Python and scikit-learn, comparing logistic regression and random forest and documenting precision and recall."
Source: synthetic dev data; date: 2026-01-15; type: case_study.

[evidence-003] "Trained a TF-IDF plus logistic regression sentiment classifier for support tickets and reported macro F1."
Source: synthetic dev data; date: 2026-04-28; type: case_study.

[evidence-004] "Compared class weighting and SMOTE for a heavily imbalanced fraud dataset and evaluated with PR-AUC instead of accuracy."
Source: synthetic dev data; date: 2026-06-10; type: case_study.
